On the enterprise side it offers DeepAgent for multi-step tasks across apps, tools for building workflows and custom chatbots with retrieval over company data and permission-aware access, plus classic machine learning for forecasting, prediction and anomaly detection. It connects to over one hundred enterprise applications and lists SSO, SAML, SOC 2, GDPR and HIPAA support with several deployment options. Prices are not shown publicly; ChatLLM has direct sign-up, and enterprise quotes come after a consultation. Check the official site for plans.

name: Radical Customer Experience
tagline: Brand-health and PR-risk modules combining AI with psychometrics.
best_for: Brands monitoring reputation and campaign risk
description:
Radical Customer Experience sells the Rx Platform, a set of AI modules for brand management that mixes sentiment analysis with psychometrics. The idea is to spot reputational trouble early instead of reacting after it spreads.

Four modules are listed: BV-Score.AI tracks and predicts brand health and vulnerability, ContentRx checks copy and imagery for misreadings or cultural insensitivity before launch, CultureRx assesses risks tied to social issues, and CrisisRx provides crisis communication tools. Companies can buy single modules or the full platform. Listed examples include consumer, fashion, tech and food brands. Predictive claims are the vendor's own and worth testing on a pilot. The listing shows monthly per-module and bundle prices; confirm current ones on the official site.
use_steps: Choose the module that matches your biggest risk.
Connect your brand and campaign content.
Review scores and flagged content before launch.
Use CrisisRx playbooks when issues escalate.
cons: Monthly cost suits businesses, not individuals
pricing_details: Listed per module monthly or as a full-platform bundle; prices may change. Check the official site.

faq.a: Yes, modules are listed individually and as a bundle.
It checks copy and imagery for misinterpretation and sentiment before launch.
Businesses protecting brand reputation.

name: Kira
tagline: AI image generator and editor focused on keeping style and characters consistent.
best_for: Marketers, designers and illustrators editing many images
description:
Kira combines text-to-image generation with a set of editing tools. You write a detailed prompt in the Generator or the Think engine, then refine the result without leaving the platform.

Editing options include background removal and replacement, inpainting and an eraser, outpainting to extend the canvas, upscaling and stylisation. Its stated focus is consistency, keeping a style or character stable across several images and edits, which matters for campaign sets and product visuals. Results download in high resolution. The listing targets marketing, e-commerce, content creation, design and illustration. Plan names and prices were not confirmed on the page, so check the official site for what is free and what is paid before relying on it.
use_steps: Open Kira and write a detailed prompt.
Generate images and pick a base.
Use Remove BG, Inpaint or Expand to refine.
Upscale and download the final image.
pros: Generation and editing in one place
pricing_details: Freemium listed but plan details unconfirmed. Check the official site.

name: Toolin
tagline: A curated directory of AI tools with community-shared Skill Packs.
best_for: People hunting for AI tools to fit a workflow
description:
Toolin is a directory for discovering and organising AI tools. The listing counts more than 250 tools across groups like AI browsers, image and video generation, design, content creation, programming and office work.

You can search and filter by keyword, category or AI model, browse editor's picks and trending tools, and see which ones offer free access. A distinctive feature is AI Skill Packs: community-shared collections of tools for a specific workflow. Anyone can submit tools or packs, though creating and publishing Skill Packs needs account activation with an invitation code. It suits creators, developers, marketers and students who want a shortlist instead of searching blindly. Pricing is not stated in the listing, so check the official site.
use_steps: Open Toolin and search by task or category.
Filter by model or free access.
Open a Skill Pack that matches your workflow.
Submit a tool you rely on.
